title: Switching from Photoshop to Photopea or GIMP
headline: How to keep your .PSD files, layers, masks, and keyboard shortcuts.

key_steps.title: 1. Opening Existing Photoshop Files
key_steps.detail: Photopea opens multi-layer .PSD files directly with smart objects, adjustment layers, clipping masks, and layer styles intact. GIMP 2.10+ opens .PSD files with standard raster layers, layer masks, and blending modes.

key_steps.title: 2. Matching Photoshop Keyboard Shortcuts
key_steps.detail: Photopea comes preconfigured with standard Photoshop shortcut keys (V for Move, B for Brush, Cmd/Ctrl+J to Duplicate, Cmd/Ctrl+T to Transform). In GIMP, go to Edit → Keyboard Shortcuts or download the 'Photoshop Shortcuts for GIMP' profile.

key_steps.title: 3. Replicating Photoshop Action & Filter Workflows
key_steps.detail: Install G'MIC (GREYC's Magic for Image Computing) in GIMP for over 500 filters including neural style transfer, film grain emulation, and frequency separation.

gotchas: Adobe proprietary adjustment layers (e.g. Color Lookup Tables with 3D LUTs) or proprietary Cloud Smart Objects may flatten in GIMP. Export key assets as high-resolution layered PSDs or TIFFs before cancelling Adobe Creative Cloud.

title: Switching from Microsoft 365 to LibreOffice
headline: Preserving document formatting, Excel formulas, and slide transitions.

key_steps.title: 1. Avoiding Font Substitution Layout Shifts
key_steps.detail: Layout shifts when opening .docx in LibreOffice are almost always caused by missing Microsoft proprietary fonts (Calibri, Aptos, Cambria). Install the Carlito and Caladea metric-compatible fonts (or standard Microsoft Core Fonts), and documents render with pixel-accurate line wraps.

key_steps.title: 2. Setting Default Save Formats to Microsoft .docx/.xlsx
key_steps.detail: If you collaborate with Office users, set LibreOffice default format: Tools → Options → Load/Save → General → Always save as Word 2010-365 (*.docx) and Excel 2010-365 (*.xlsx).

key_steps.title: 3. Excel Formulas and Pivot Tables
key_steps.detail: LibreOffice Calc provides broad formula compatibility with Excel (including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and SUMIFS). Pivot Tables (Data → Pivot Table) support standard data aggregation. Note: Highly complex nested formulas, proprietary VBA macros, and Power Pivot models require Microsoft Excel. (Source: The Document Foundation Calc Documentation, verified October 2026).

gotchas: Complex Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) macros with proprietary Windows ActiveX controls require reviewing or porting to LibreOffice Basic or Python scripting.

title: Switching from Notion to Obsidian
headline: Liberating your personal database and notes into local Markdown files you own forever.

key_steps.title: 1. Exporting Your Notion Workspace
key_steps.detail: In Notion, click Settings & Members → Settings → Export all workspace content → Select 'Markdown & CSV' with 'Include subpages' enabled. Download the generated ZIP file.

key_steps.title: 2. Importing into an Obsidian Vault
key_steps.detail: Create a new Obsidian Vault pointing to a local folder on your computer. Use the official 'Notion Importer' community plugin in Obsidian (Settings → Community Plugins → Importer → Notion) to convert Notion databases and callouts into clean Markdown with embedded images.

key_steps.title: 3. Replicating Notion Databases & Kanban Boards
key_steps.detail: Install the community 'Dataview' and 'Kanban' plugins in Obsidian. Dataview enables SQL-like queries across your notes (e.g. status = 'in progress', due_date < date(today)), rendering instant interactive tables.

gotchas: Notion's nested page URLs will become local wikilinks [[Page Name]]. Complex relational formulas should be set up via Obsidian Dataview or the Projects plugin.

title: Switching from 1Password or LastPass to Bitwarden
headline: Zero-downtime password migration with end-to-end zero-knowledge encryption.

key_steps.title: 1. Export Vault from Old Manager
key_steps.detail: In 1Password, choose File → Export → All Items (.1pux or .csv). In LastPass, go to Advanced Options → Export → Enter Master Password → Save as CSV.

key_steps.title: 2. Import Directly into Bitwarden
key_steps.detail: Log in to vault.bitwarden.com → Tools → Import Data → Select '1Password (.1pux)' or 'LastPass (csv)' from the dropdown → Select file and click Import. All logins, secure notes, cards, and 2FA seeds transfer in seconds.

key_steps.title: 3. Permanently Shred the Unencrypted Export
key_steps.detail: CRITICAL: The exported .csv file contains plaintext passwords. After confirming everything is visible in Bitwarden, immediately shred/delete the export file from your downloads folder and empty trash.

gotchas: Disable browser password autofill in Chrome/Safari to prevent conflicting double-autofill popups.

title: Switching from Premiere Pro to DaVinci Resolve
headline: Exporting timelines, XML projects, and switching to industry-standard color grading.

file_support.opens_native: FCP XML (.xml), EDL, AAF, MP4, MOV, Apple ProRes, Blackmagic RAW, Sony/Canon RAW
file_support.exports_to: ProRes, H.264, H.265, QuickTime, IMF, DCP, Final Cut XML

key_steps.title: 1. Exporting XML from Premiere
key_steps.detail: In Premiere Pro, select your active sequence → File → Export → Final Cut Pro XML (*.xml). This exports edit cuts, track positions, volume points, and clip timing.

key_steps.title: 2. Importing XML Timeline into Resolve
key_steps.detail: In DaVinci Resolve, go to File → Import → Timeline → Select your exported XML file. Resolve automatically reconnects cuts, track positions, and standard crossfades. Note: Proprietary Premiere Motion effects, Essential Graphics mogrts, and third-party effects must be manually rebuilt. (Source: Blackmagic Design Resolve Reference Manual, verified October 2026).

key_steps.title: 3. Switching Keyboard Shortcuts to Premiere Layout
key_steps.detail: Go to DaVinci Resolve → Keyboard Customization → Top right dropdown → Select 'Adobe Premiere Pro'. All your muscle memory (C for Razor cut, Q/W for ripple trim, J-K-L shuttle) transfers seamlessly.

gotchas: Third-party Adobe After Effects dynamic links or proprietary Premiere plugins (e.g. Essential Graphics templates) should be rendered out as ProRes/DNxHR clips prior to XML export.
